features: Fellowes brings stylized garment storage to cubicles with the Partition Additions Coat Hook and Clip system.

Use the clip to securely grip smaller essentials such as hats, gloves, or notes.

description: Fellowes brings stylized garment storage to cubicles with the Partition Additions Coat Hook & Clip system. This sleek unit features a hook that folds out to hold coats, umbrellas, or even easel pads, then folds back up when you don’t need it. Use the clip to securely grip smaller essentials such as hats, gloves, or notes. Durable cast-aluminum construction ensures lasting performance. Adjustable bracket fits standard cubicle walls (1.5 to 3.25 Inches). Hook capacity – 15 lbs; clip capacity – 50 sheets.
